messages:
alex: quick question — need to give maya (contractor) access to view LLM request traces in project `redwood-prod-debug` for a 2-4h debug window. they should only see redacted traces (no raw PII). thoughts on least-priv approach? @jamie @maria

jamie: don't grant org-level roles. make a project-scoped custom role with the minimal perms and use a time-bound condition. also prefer granting dataset-level access for BigQuery instead of broad project roles.

sam: can we use `jit-access-bot` for a 4h temporary grant? that's our standard flow for contractors.

alex: traces are exported to `bigquery:redwood-prod-debug.llm_traces_redacted`. note: some columns are masked but there are a couple of free-text fields we should double-check. no KMS unwrap required — we don't have decrypted secrets in these traces.

maria: privacy check — are the traces sanitized by the redaction pipeline? if there's any doubt, do not grant direct access; instead ask eng-ml to run a safe subset export.

jamie: proposed role perms (minimal):
```
- logging.logEntries.list
- bigquery.tables.get
- bigquery.tables.getData
- bigquery.jobs.create (for running limited queries)
```
and bind it to `dataset:llm_traces_redacted` only. no storage or kms perms.

alex: can we add a condition on the binding like `request.time < timestamp('2026-03-14T22:00:00Z')` so it auto-expires?

sam: yep. example gcloud snippet (will create a custom role first, then binding):
```bash
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod-debug \
  --member="user:maya@contractor.com" \
  --role="projects/redwood-prod-debug/roles/llmTraceViewer" \
  --condition="expression=request.time < timestamp('2026-03-14T22:00:00Z'),title=temporary_access"
```

maria: also run our quick privacy scan before granting: `python tools/trace-scan.py --dataset=llm_traces_redacted --sample 1000`. if any matches of PII patterns show up, stop and escalate.

jit-access-bot: Request created (#4571) by alex for maya@contractor.com — approver: @jamie. Use `/jit approve 4571` to auto-apply binding.

jamie: approved. i'll create the custom role `llmTraceViewer` with the perms above and attach the time-bound binding.

alex: thanks — i'll kick off the JIT flow now and paste the request link here when it's ready.

sam: ping me after it's applied, i'll watch audit logs for unusual queries.

alex: :thumbsup: will do.

maria: small note — we should add an audit ticket to confirm the dataset has no unmasked fields after the session.

alex: adding ticket: ENG-4921.

sam: thanks all, nice and quick.
